youtube.title: 3 accessibility checks for any training course

media.alt: Text-led reel with the K&A Performance logo and ka-performancefl.com at the top of every frame. Hook: Training everyone can take. 3 checks for any course: 1 Captions on every video, 2 Text you can read, 3 It works with a keyboard. Real screens from our sample courses. Check 1: Captions on every video. A transcript for all audio. Try it: turn the sound off. Can you still follow? A real phone screen of the RFI sample course zooms in on its audio introduction with the full transcript. Check 2: Text you can read. Try it: measure the contrast. Body text needs at least 4.5:1. Measured on this screen: 10.3:1, with the body text of the strength sample course outlined. Check 3: It works with a keyboard. Try it: put the mouse away. Press Tab. Can you see where you are? A Tab key is pressed and the safety sample course hazard hunt shows a focus ring on Ladder access; Enter is pressed and the ladder is marked found. Enter marks it found. No mouse needed. A progress row of three boxes fills as each check passes. Ends on: Accessibility is part of how we build training, with the Accessibility throughout the build panel from the K&A training page, Try our sample courses, free on the site, ka-performancefl.com/training, Call Alex 904-210-1071.
